about.title: About Us
about.intro: FlySky Network is a digital entertainment platform that combines virtual mining, interactive games, and in-app rewards into one smooth and engaging experience.
about.vision: To deliver an innovative entertainment platform that offers users a fun and rewarding experience, with a focus on simplicity and accessibility.
about.mission: We provide users with exciting games and challenges where they can collect virtual points and use them to unlock additional in-app benefits.

features.earn: Earn FSN points by participating in daily activities.
features.unlock: Use your points to unlock features and enhance your experience within the app.
features.enjoy: Enjoy interactive games and various in-app rewards.

fsnPoints.title: FSN Points
fsnPoints.description: FSN points are purely virtual in-app currency, used exclusively to unlock features, join games, and access activities. They cannot be withdrawn, sold, or traded outside the app.

battleLegend.title: Battle Legend Game
battleLegend.description: Get ready for thrilling adventures in Battle Legend, where you can compete and win rewards — all within the app.

about.join: Join us and be part of the future of digital entertainment!

features.mining: Start earning FSN tokens through our energy-efficient proof-of-activity model.
features.staking: Stake your digital tokens and watch your assets grow while supporting the network.
features.gaming: Enjoy exciting games that reward your skills with real digital assets.
features.nft: Trade unique NFTs and unlock exclusive items and collectibles within games.

whitepaper.overview: A comprehensive document outlining our project's philosophy, technical architecture, and future plans.
whitepaper.intro: FlySky Network is designed to redefine the user-tech relationship by integrating multiple digital elements into one ecosystem.
whitepaper.tokenIntro: FSN is the cornerstone of the FlySky economy, used for mining, staking, purchases, and rewards.
whitepaper.phase: We follow a phased execution plan that includes pre-sale, public sale, and full launch stages.
whitepaper.mainSale: The main sale occurs in stages, ensuring fair allocation and complete transparency.
whitepaper.uses: The token is used for: mining, rewards, marketplace fees, governance, and character development within games.
whitepaper.gameIntro: Battle Legend is the first Survive-to-Earn game combining strategy, entertainment, and rewards.
whitepaper.gameDetails: The game offers vehicles, weapons, and a resource system within a fully integrated economy based on the BLT token.
whitepaper.status: Currently in the pre-sale preparation phase, with a clear roadmap for each stage.
whitepaper.roadmapDesc: Includes development stages, partnerships, launch, and ecosystem expansion.
whitepaper.securityDesc: We use smart contracts and blockchain technology to ensure integrity and protect users.
whitepaper.conclusionDesc: FlySky Network represents the unified future of technology, economy, and entertainment. Join us now.
whitepaper.join: Be part of the digital revolution — Join FlySky Network now.
whitepaper.battleLegend: Part of our ecosystem is Battle Legend — the first 'Survive to Earn' game that combines fun combat, customizable vehicles, and an integrated economy powered by the BLT token.
